notes: INSIDE half of the Human Flak Screen: a belt of amber flak shells in a feed channel; shells slide along the belt as it charges (frame 5 = belt full, strip green), power coupling, hatch. fire: the belt jerks and the strip flashes. damaged: the belt jammed with a crooked shell, lamps dead; disabled: the belt snapped, shells spilled. Barrel layer human_flak_screen_barrel: a round head with twin short flak barrels and a small radar dish on top; it shoots down missiles. COMPACT (tier 1-2 parts take less room inside): this inside half is the centre of the original art between its own edge columns, re-outlined (art/_src/compact.py).
